entities.name: Layer 3 Message
entities.description: Standard L3 messages defined in 3GPP TS 24.007, with defined structure including imperative and non-imperative parts.

entities.name: Information Element
entities.description: Component of L3 messages with specific format, coding, and presence requirements. Includes IEI, name, type, presence requirement, format, and length.

entities.name: Information Element Identifier
entities.description: Hexadecimal identifier for IEs with format T, TV, TLV, or TLV-E. Can be half-octet length.

entities.name: Presence Requirement
entities.description: Defines whether an IE is Mandatory (M), Conditional (C), or Optional (O) in a message.

entities.name: IE Format
entities.description: Coding format of IEs: T, V, TV, LV, TLV, LV-E, or TLV-E as defined in TS 24.007.

entities.name: Message Significance
entities.description: Scope of message relevance: Local, Access, Dual, or Global significance.

relations.description: Messages contain Information Elements in a specified order, with imperative part IEs (V, LV, LV-E) preceding non-imperative part IEs (T, TV, TLV, TLV-E).
Information Elements with formats T, TV, TLV, or TLV-E include an Information Element Identifier.
IE inclusion in a message is governed by presence requirements (M, C, O).
IE coding and structure are defined by its format (T, V, TV, LV, TLV, LV-E, TLV-E).
Message usage and direction are defined by its significance (Local, Access, Dual, Global).
